module: Checks the internal consistency of a rally note compositor style (file under compositors/styles/). It checks the distance table (callsEnabled, links with increasing thresholds, base/large/point units, rounding, max), the componentTypes components (corner with numbering/intensity/lengths/direction, caution, modifiers, modifierAliases) and the system notes via notebook/systemPacenotes. It enforces no common schema between styles: each style can define its own types. Each error is logged (log 'E', tag styleValidator) and validation stops at the first error.
notes: Intensity/length ranges must be explicit {min, max} tables (not {a, b}), contiguous from 0: each min equals the previous max; max may be missing only on the last range and must be greater than min.
distance.links must be a non-empty array of {threshold = number, text = string|nil} with strictly increasing thresholds.
Allowed top-level keys of componentTypes are: corner, caution, modifiers, modifierAliases; any other key is rejected (atomic modifiers go in componentTypes.modifiers).

validate.desc: Validates a style. Called by textCompositor:load after applying the calibrations; on failure the style is not loaded.

name.desc: Style name for error messages ('?' by default).

returns.desc: true if the style is valid.
